fixed.explanation: gitDiff fetches the PR base hash with --depth=1, which makes a full clone shallow. Dropping --depth=1 when the repo is complete fixes this. Simplest: check whether the repo is shallow and only pass --depth=1 in that case.

query.intent: Code that captures git diff on CI pull requests runs git fetch with a depth option (e.g. --depth=1) to get the base commit, which makes a full clone shallow. It should avoid shallowing the repo, e.g. not use --depth or only deepen when already shallow.
query.symptom: On CI pull request builds, the git diff capture runs a shallow fetch that converts a complete clone into a shallow clone.
